# A single gradient label does not supply a class Gamma payment

This is an exact actual mixed-body calibration of the limits of the new
gradient-labeled volume transport. The full-space parameter is a GLOBAL
minimum for the fixed body, the unique buffered deepest mark is the true
uniform mixed centroid, the full-space transport has one source, and ALL
proper closed-minor quotas are strict. Nevertheless its raw maximal
buffered depth is strictly below Gamma_d times the volume of its sole
gradient class. It is not a joint body/parameter minimum and not an OC
counterexample.

## 1. Canonical body and exact original mean

Let n=2,d=1 and

    P={(i,j) in Z^2:i>=0,j>=0,i+j<=3},
    C=conv(P) times [-1,1],      K_z=[-1,1] for all z.

P has ten points and four occupied parities. All fibers have length 2,
the original total mass is M=20, and C is precisely the sampled convex
hull. Their original full-space centroid is

    Y=((1,1),0).

Indeed each base coordinate sums to 10 and all interval centroids are
zero. The actual within-fiber covariance is 1/3, so G(u)=|u|/sqrt(3).
For L=1 and |y|<=1 the ordinary interval energy and buffer are

    E_[-1,1](y)=2(1-y^2),
    delta(y)=epsilon sqrt[(1-y^2)/30].                    (1)

Take 0<epsilon<=1. All bounds below hold in this explicit range.

## 2. All bases and all source marks are controlled

Put p=(1,1). Seven bases form a centrally symmetric core about p: p and
the three pairs

    (1,0),(1,2);       (2,0),(0,2);       (0,1),(2,1).

The corresponding fourteen units of mixed interval volume are symmetric
about Y in the FULL space. Every containing closed ambient halfspace
therefore captures at least half of that core. Buffered halfspaces at Y
contain Y, so

    b_1(Y)>=7.                                           (2)

Every other base is on the boundary of the lattice triangle. At a vertex,
a closed pure-base cap isolates just that vertex, of mass 2. At an edge
interior base a closed pure-base cap isolates it together with the nearer
vertex on that edge, of mass 4. Explicit outward normals for the six
edge interior points are

    (1,0):(-1,-4),    (2,0):(1,-4),
    (0,1):(-4,-1),    (0,2):(-4,1),
    (1,2):(3,4),     (2,1):(4,3).

For each row take a.z>=a.p. Thus EVERY mark at EVERY other base has
buffered depth at most 4, for any parameter. This is an all-source bound.

The pure-base depth at p is exactly 10. Each of the three symmetric
nonzero pairs contributes at least one point to any closed through-p
base cap, in addition to p itself. The three remaining relative vectors
are (-1,-1),(-1,2),(2,-1), whose sum is zero; every such cap contains at
least one of them. Hence it contains at least five bases. The normal
(10,1) attains five, giving mass 10.

At Y take continuous normal u=1 and base coefficient a=(20,2), using
relative base coordinates z-p. Four other bases have a.(z-p)>=2 and
five have a.(z-p)<=-2. Since delta(0)=epsilon/sqrt(30)<1, the buffered
cap

    a.(z-p)+X>=-delta(0)

contains the four positive fibers fully, the five negative fibers not
at all, and length 1+delta(0) of the own fiber. Consequently

    b_1(Y)<=9+epsilon/sqrt(30)<10.                       (3)

On the middle fiber the buffered depth for L=1 is even in y by X-reflection.
Its superlevels are convex because f is concave, so its maximum is at
y=0. That maximum is UNIQUE. Otherwise reflection would give distinct
maximizers y and -y. Their midpoint has a proper attained cap because
(3) is strictly below its pure-base depth 10. Its exact upper quantile,
together with the endpoint depth inequalities, would force equality
in the strict concavity of sqrt(1-y^2), contrary to y!=0. This argument
retains every possible oblique cap; it does not infer deepestness from
one critical menu or a local Hessian.

Combining (2)--(3) and the boundary-base covers, the unique global
buffered deepest mark is Y, it is proper, and its raw depth Q satisfies

    7<=Q<=9+epsilon/sqrt(30)<10=Gamma_1 M.                (4)

The exact value of Q is not needed or claimed.

## 3. L=1 globally minimizes over all concave logarithmic parameters

Keep the body fixed and allow ANY positive continuous concave full-space
L with <log L>=0. Jensen for the concave function log L at the true
uniform mixed centroid gives

    log L(Y)>=<log L>=0,       hence L(Y)>=1.

The buffered depth at a fixed mark increases with that mark's parameter
value. Thus

    max_w b_L(w)>=b_L(Y)>=b_1(Y)=Q.

L=1 is a global parameter minimum over this entire class. No uniqueness
of the parameter minimum is needed. This is substantially more than an
arbitrary prescribed source or a detached formal moment calibration,
but it does not establish stationarity under body changes.

The full-space transport at L=1 is exactly

    sigma_1=1,       mu=delta_Y,       nu=dm/20.

Its one row has mean Y, its parameter mean is one, and it uses the full
original uniform target. There is one continuous-gradient label c=0,
with M_c=20 and source parity count k_c=1. Nevertheless (4) gives

    Q<Gamma_1 M_c/k_c.

Therefore a per-label Gamma payment does NOT follow from the full-space
martingale, gradient-labeled original mass, graded source parity, or
even fixed-body global concave-parameter optimality. Some additional
joint-body variational mechanism would be indispensable.

## 4. Every strict closed-minor quota also holds

For a proper nonempty closed minor T=P intersect conv(T), its mass is
2|T|. Since k(P)=4 and M=20, the quota is exactly

    2|T|<5 k(T).

The companion exact verifier checks all 1022 nonempty proper subsets by
integer convex-hull predicates, including segments and singleton cases.
Exactly 274 are closed minors. Their counts and minimum positive quota
slacks 5k(T)-2|T|, by parity count, are

| k(T) | number | minimum slack |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 10 | 3 |
| 2 | 45 | 2 |
| 3 | 93 | 5 |
| 4 | 126 | 2 |

Thus the missing payment cannot be inferred from those scalar quotas
either. The actual family is safely ABOVE the OC target Gamma_1 M/k(P)
=5/2, since its depth is at least 7. This example protects the scope of
the new gradient/parity identities; it does not refute them.
